title: Network Activity event (flow and connection telemetry for containment, DDoS response and segmentation posture)
summary: OCSF Network Activity events consumed on three surfaces: ddos_response reads traffic-rate and endpoint-spread records at detect-availability-anomaly, classify-attack-vector and validate-service-restoration; network_security reads observed flows to inventory segments, evaluate segmentation policy, detect boundary-crossing violations and verify enforcement; ransomware_containment and data_exfil read flow records to verify the network-ACL isolation fallback and to bound observed egress volume at scope assessment. One class shape serves all four because each consumes the same flow five-tuple plus direction and byte counts — the playbooks differ in which endpoints and windows they filter, not in the record shape.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Network Activity category — Network Activity class (uid 4001)
